invariant_bindings.invariant_text: A successful commit MUST apply every registered new, dirty, and removed object in a single atomic transaction; on any exception the unit MUST rollback.
The same object instance SHALL NEVER be registered in more than one of new, dirty, or removed within one unit.
A UnitOfWork instance CANNOT be reused after commit or rollback; a fresh unit MUST be opened for the next transaction.
Context-manager semantics ALWAYS drive lifecycle so leaks on exception paths are impossible; on exception the unit MUST rollback.
Repositories operating inside a unit MUST enlist their mutations with that unit; direct writes bypassing the unit are FORBIDDEN.
